transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's a burning when I pass water, and I'm needing to go much more often than usual. It started about four days ago and it's very uncomfortable.
When did you first notice it?
I first noticed it four days ago. It came on and has been bothering me since then.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
I haven't really noticed anything that makes it better or worse. It's just there when I pass water, and the need to go keeps coming back.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a stinging, burning feeling when I pass water, about a 5 out of 10. It's uncomfortable, but I'm managing.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's down below, in the water passage, when I pass urine. I haven't noticed it spreading anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
It's about a 5 out of 10. It's uncomfortable, but I'm managing.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
The stinging is mainly when I pass water. I don't have it all the time otherwise, but I do keep needing to go.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
The urine looks cloudy and smells stronger than usual. I haven't seen any blood, and I've not had a fever, shivers, back or side pain, or vomiting.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I have an underactive thyroid and thin bones. I take levothyroxine every morning and alendronic acid once a week for that.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?

I take levothyroxine 75 micrograms each morning, and alendronic acid 70 mg once a week for my thin bones. I also use a vaginal cream from the hospital twice a week, but I can't remember the name of it.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Yes, I'm allergic to trimethoprim. It gave me an itchy rash.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes, I've stopped going to the residents' coffee morning in case I can't reach a toilet in time. That's the main thing I've had to give up.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I think it's another water infection — I had one about a year ago that was treated with antibiotics. I'm hoping I can get antibiotics before the weekend.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
